tickets.title: AI Copilot: Operational AI Assistant
tickets.description: Context-aware reviewer assistant integrated into Reviewer Workspace with explanations, feedback loop and guardrails.
acceptance_criteria: Displays explanations and model metadata for suggestions
Logs suggestions to immutable audit store with correlation IDs
Provides reviewer feedback control stored for learning pipeline

tickets.title: Immutable Audit Logging
tickets.description: Append-only audit log service for reviewer actions, AI suggestions, policy changes and exports.
acceptance_criteria: Cryptographically chained or immutable-backed audit entries
APIs for write/read with tenant scoping
Logs actor, timestamp, before/after state, and retention metadata
Administrators can export tenant-scoped audit trails

tickets.title: Dashboard Drilldowns & Exports (Executive)
tickets.description: Complete Executive Dashboard drilldowns, scheduled export, and tenant-aware access controls.
acceptance_criteria: Drilldown endpoints return paginated, tenant-scoped data with RBAC enforcement
Scheduled exports write to tenant-isolated storage

tickets.title: Reviewer Workspace Enhancements (Bulk Actions)
tickets.description: Multi-select bulk reviewer actions with safety checks and workflow versioning support.
acceptance_criteria: UI multi-select and preview of mass action effects
Backend dry-run validation and impact summary
Bulk actions create workflow version records and are logged

tickets.title: Notification Prioritization
tickets.description: Intelligent notification prioritization to reduce alert fatigue.
acceptance_criteria: Notifications ranked by rules and AI scoring
